additional_info.subject: RE: ID0375737-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / R1 170001227] OCPP Offline CRM:00579001042
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen,
Greetings of the day!
We have checked the router settings and found that -
On Teltonika WebUI in Main WAN section - 2 Mobile (WAN) options were showing and No Wi-Fi (WAN) option. There should be 3 different options i.e. Mobile, Wi-Fi, Wired.
With certain change in router settings, brought back the Wifi option as below:
Also we found Internet to be disconnected. We also observed that, internet got disconnected almost around 3-4 times in 1 hr.
We restarted connection and Internet found to be connected. (See below)
Also the Force LTE network was not enabled. We enabled the same for the stable 4G connection.
With the above change in router settings, the OCPP is found to be Online now.
If still the OCPP connection is unstable after this, then we need to check the sim (Whether there is network issue or data exhausted or.....,etc)
Do let us know if there are any other queries or should we proceed to close this case?
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
